spoken_binding_changes.before: An applicant must disclose a verifiable Social Security number or establish the exemption with an unexpired I-ninety-four or I-94A arrival-and-departure record in a valid foreign passport.
spoken_binding_changes.after: An applicant must disclose a verifiable Social Security number or establish the exemption with an unexpired I-ninety-four or I-ninety-four A arrival-and-departure record in a valid foreign passport.

spoken_binding_changes.before: An unexpired I-ninety-four or I-94A is accepted for lawful status and identity with a valid foreign passport, except the passport is unnecessary for a Refugee stamp or Canadian place of origin; F1, F2, J1, J2, M1 and M2 applicants also need an I-twenty and or or DS-two thousand nineteen, and a Refugee stamp may require an I-seven hundred ninety-seven.
spoken_binding_changes.after: An unexpired I-ninety-four or I-ninety-four A is accepted for lawful status and identity with a valid foreign passport, except the passport is unnecessary for a Refugee stamp or Canadian place of origin; F one, F two, J one, J two, M one and M two applicants also need an I-twenty and or or DS-two thousand nineteen, and a Refugee stamp may require an I-seven hundred ninety-seven.

spoken_binding_changes.before: Applicants with F1, F2, J1, J2, M1 or M2 status must also supply an I-twenty and or or DS-two thousand nineteen for SEVIS information.
spoken_binding_changes.after: Applicants with F one, F two, J one, J two, M one or M two status must also supply an I-twenty and or or DS-two thousand nineteen for SEVIS information.

spoken_binding_changes.before: For an I-ninety-four or I-94A arrival record, the foreign passport is unnecessary when the record is stamped Refugee or the place of origin is Canada.
spoken_binding_changes.after: For an I-ninety-four or I-ninety-four A arrival record, the foreign passport is unnecessary when the record is stamped Refugee or the place of origin is Canada.

spoken_binding_changes.before: A Refugee-stamped I-ninety-four or I-94A may require an I-seven hundred ninety-seven.
spoken_binding_changes.after: A Refugee-stamped I-ninety-four or I-ninety-four A may require an I-seven hundred ninety-seven.

spoken_binding_changes.before: Forms I-one hundred fifty-one, I-94W and I-ninety-four Border Crosser are not accepted for this identity and lawful-status documentation pathway.
spoken_binding_changes.after: Forms I-one hundred fifty-one, I-ninety-four W and I-ninety-four Border Crosser are not accepted for this identity and lawful-status documentation pathway.
